description: Text to speech (TTS) with speed control: turn text into spoken WAV audio at a chosen speaking speed (0.7x to 2.0x) and quality steps (1-100), in 10 standard voices and 31 languages. Base voices only (no personas). Use it for faster, slower or more deliberate delivery. Costs $0.005 for 1-500 chars or $0.006 for 501-2000 chars. Charged only for a 200 that carries audio: the service refuses with 400 before payment (charged:false) text with no letter or digit, text whose script does not match lang, non-Latin text without lang, speed outside 0.7-2.0, steps outside 1-100, or an unknown voice, lang or response_format; audio that fails its post-synthesis check answers 502 with charged:false.

lang.description: Language code, default en for Latin-script text; must match the script of the text and is required for non-Latin text
